original: The Perche Regional Natural Park is a French regional natural park created in 1998. It covers part of the natural region of Perche. It covers 194 114 hectares and two departments: Orne to the west and Eure-et-Loir to the east. 88 communes are members of the park's charter, or 78,920 inhabitants. The team that leads him is currently chaired by Anick Bruneau and led by Denis Guillemin.
